breadth_formula.asset_pass: date-t close is above its 43-week simple moving average and its date-t 26-week return is positive
breadth_formula.risk_on: SPY and QQQ both pass and at least the configured fraction of available breadth-universe ETFs pass
breadth_formula.execution: date-t information transforms weights that earn the t-to-t+1 return

selection_rule: Among candidates passing every gate, select the highest recent-three-year 50-bps CAGR; break ties by higher 100-bps CAGR, then lower name. Already-observed history can create only a frozen forward challenger, never a profitability claim.
forward_rule: If and only if a candidate qualifies, write an immutable research manifest. Its untouched forward clock cannot start until its complete upstream GGG decision engine can produce post-freeze holdings from contemporaneous data.
scope_limits: No real-money execution or broker connection.
No parameter sweep beyond these twelve named candidates.
The historical ETF universe and GGG lineage retain the limitations in the frozen upstream manifest.
The April 2026 GGG research data are not extended or overwritten by the August free-data vintage.
